input_declaration: Auditor read only the designated capsule and wrote only its result; repository, conversation, other results and hidden expectations were not accessed.
execution_caveat: Each run recovered from one policy-declined read-only command; no MCP call failed, no timeout or write occurred, and all usage was complete.
proof_scope: Proves candidate-side native progressive LSP behavior and absolute token/time cost only; it does not prove causal savings against an old control.
